view: orthographic-looking top-down view of a flat uniform grey ground (RGB 140,140,140); +x right, +y down in image

camera.motion: static (uniform background, no features; no shift detectable)
camera.perspective: none visible; top-down, both objects keep constant pixel size, treat as one plane / one scale

cyclist.description: person riding a teal/cyan bicycle, dark clothing, seen from above, upper lane (y ~381); moves toward -x (left)
cyclist.track: tracks/cyclist.csv (whole rider+bike), tracks/cyclist_parts.csv (teal bike only + dark pixels)
cyclist.reference_point: bbox centre (= bike centre within 1.6 px); rider torso/pelvis lies ~10 px further back (+x) than bbox centre
cyclist.motion_px_per_frame: constant ~26.6 px/frame toward -x (frames 1-71); frame 0 and 1 identical position

car.description: Cybertruck-like pickup: white/silver body, black glass roof, dark bed at rear (right), side mirrors; lower lane (y ~727); front points left, moves toward -x
car.reference_point: bbox centre when fully visible; when cut by the frame edge use centre_x_full (front edge + (L-1)/2 or rear edge - (L-1)/2, L=726)
car.motion_px_per_frame: starts from (near) rest at frame 1-2, accelerates roughly uniformly (~1.5 px/frame^2 front-edge) to ~62 px/frame by ~frame 67, then ~constant

static_objects: none: flat grey ground only, no markings, no props

events.event: cyclist already moving at start (frames 0 and 1 same position, then ~26.6 px/frame)
car front edge passes cyclist front edge (overtake begins)
car acceleration ends / speed levels off ~62 px/frame
